subject: Dedicated capacity intake — throughput/latency qualification & scheduling

From: Tim Byrne <tim.byrne@acyon-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 21:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Demo request — dedicated capacity for inference at scale

Hi Mina,

We signed up via the self-serve flow and got some promising initial numbers. Our use case is low-latency dedicated inference for a real-time personalization feature (on-line ranking + short-context completion). Before we book a full technical walkthrough, I wanted to share a high-level profile so your team can prepare:

- Peak concurrent requests: ~120 active sessions (burst to 200)
- Avg tokens per request: 300 tokens
- Expected throughput: ~8M tokens/day initially, ramp to 25M in Q4
- SLA target: p95 end-to-end latency <250ms (US/EU users), p50 ~120ms
- Model preferences: open Llama-family variants; we may test a 7B and a 13B quantized variant
- Data sensitivity: low/medium (no PHI), but need audit logs and VPC option

Can we schedule a 30–45 minute dedicated-capacity intake this week to align on architecture and minimum config? We are UK-based (BST) and generally available Tue-Thu afternoons.

Thanks,
Tim Byrne\Head of Platform\Acyon Analytics

Attachments: mqp_requirements.pdf (internal traffic profile)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: Pr iyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — dedicated capacity for inference at scale

Hi Tim — thanks for the details, that profile is super helpful. Short answers up front: Dedicated is a great fit for predictable throughput and VPC/visibility needs. We can definitely walk through sizing and a staged rollout to validate p95 latency targets.

Two quick asks before the call so the right folks show up:
- Can you confirm target qps (requests/sec) during a burst and an expected concurrent KV cache size (approx per-session context)?
- Which cloud region(s) are your users primarily in (EU/US/APAC)?
- Do you have a preferred date/time window; we can propose CET-friendly slots to match the BST timezone.

Proposed slots (BST/CET friendly):
- Wed Jun 9: 10:30–11:15 BST / 11:30–12:15 CET
- Thu Jun 10: 15:00–15:45 BST / 16:00–16:45 CET
- Fri Jun 11: 09:00–09:45 BST / 10:00–10:45 CET

I'll pull David (Sales Engineer) onto the call for a quick throughput/latency checklist. Pr iyom will send over a calendar invite once we confirm.

I've attached a short intake worksheet that helps us size Dedicated pools — please take a minute to fill the key fields (we only need the cells with *).

Best,
Mina Haddad\Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: dedicated_capacity_estimate.xlsx (fill-first tab)

Thanks Mina — attached the filled intake (see mqp_requirements.pdf updated) and a short network diagram. Quick clarifications:

- Burst qps: 6–8 req/s sustained bursts, but behavior is spiky with sub-second peaks; typical steady state ~2.5 req/s.
- Context per-session: 2–3KV entries, avg 330KB total KV cache per active session (we know that's high — looking to cache only recent items).
- Regions: Primary EU (Ireland), backup US-East.

We can do Thu Jun 10 at 15:00 BST — would you prefer 30 or 45 minutes? 45 preferred so we can run a short load profile example.

On a side note, are there standard NPI/PO terms we should be aware of for a Dedicated pilot? We may need an initial 3-month reserved capacity run.

—Tim
